name: f9_structural_song_raw_adc_exploratory_v1
source: Song S01/S02 raw-ADC formal windows, source-fitted F9v2 and mask at 250Hz
validation: Song S03 formal trials; session readiness failed
descriptive_final: Song S04 formal trials; previously inspected
rule: Reject a native trial only if any formal window has any channel zero fraction >=0.50, longest flatline ratio >=0.50, or known-ADC clip fraction >=0.10. Use the actual signed 24-bit ADC rails -8388608 and 8388607 and the previously fixed source state. Do not use soft amplitude, correlation, line or low-frequency shifts for rejection.
control: Join unchanged source-S01/S02 F0 trial probabilities by native trial ID. Separately inject a constant channel into copied target windows to verify a structural event is observable; label this synthetic.
report: Per S03/S04: native-trial coverage, previously correct trials rejected, errors rejected, baseline errors; window structural counts and synthetic constant-channel detection. No threshold tuning on either target session.
limits: Single person and one calendar day, no validated re-donning, uncertain original packet bytes and cue onset. Both target sessions and the earlier quality mask were inspected before this rule. This is exploratory, not physical-fault sensitivity, independent final validation or live deployment.
